title: The Prophet Judges Ahab Through the Parable of the Escaped Prisoner
description: A prophet's disciple asks another man to strike him at the Lord's command, but the man refuses and is killed by a lion. Another man then strikes him so that he is wounded. The prophet disguises himself with ash over his eyes and waits for King Ahab along the road. He tells the king a made-up story about a prisoner he was ordered to guard, who escaped, and the king passes judgment on himself. Then the prophet removes the bandage, and the king recognizes him. The prophet declares the Lord's word: because Ahab set free the man whom the Lord had devoted to destruction, his life shall be for that man's life, and his people for that man's people. Ahab goes home to Samaria, angry and gloomy.
